name: Super Mario 64

needs.hint: Put a .z64, .v64 or .n64 dump in Roms/N64 (any name) or as App/SuperMario64/rom.z64.
needs.title: SUPER MARIO 64

about: Native N64 port built from the Super Mario 64 decompilation. No emulation: runs on the Mini's CPU with a software renderer. Save states (9 slots + auto save). First start takes about a minute.
